items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: My uncle, my two uncle, and bro, and my brother.

ctx.x: Well, we never did get your first job straight, that was your uncle? Who's that? And on your very first job, you said that was in the country with your uncle and bro?
My uncle, my two uncle, and bro, and my brother. They were one, Nelson Joseph, you know, the one at the shop, yes.
And what instruments were they playing then?
